name: AuthorCard
summary: Who wrote this: avatar, name, a line of bio and a link, in a glass panel at the end of an article.

guidance.useFor: The end of a post, before related posts; an about page's team list.
insteadUse: The author in the byline: Article header
content: One or two lines about what they work on
The link names where it goes: "More posts by Sam"

rungReason: A <section> named by aria-label is a region; native text and a link. Not an aside: a named aside inside main is a nested complementary landmark (ADR-0011).
rules: The avatar is decorative: the name is written beside it
Wraps the link under the text when narrow (WCAG 1.4.10)
contrast: An opaque surface (--lue-color-bg-surface) under increased contrast, reduced transparency or without backdrop-filter
